Lena (social): Quick plan: 48h social sprint to amplify the upcoming benchmark webinar. Need a hero stat card, 15s clip, 2 copy variants, and clear routing for leads.

Maya (growth): Goal is demo requests. Split test register vs download CTA. Track utm=webinar_sprint and utm_variant=A/B.

Diego (design): Can do hero PNG + vertical crop. ETA: Mon AM. Will include alt text.

Rosa (sdr): Routing: tag all leads with tag 'webinar_sprint'. Attendees -> queue inbound-webinar. Demo CTA -> enterprise-sdr. I'll post CRM mapping.

Lena (social): Posting windows: Mon 10:00 PT (teaser), Tue 11:30 PT (stat), Wed 08:00 PT (reminder), Wed 10:00 PT (1h). EU boost Tue 16:00 CET for stat card.

Maya (growth): Also add utm_region=eu/us so we can split performance.

OpsBot: Suggested slots saved as "sprint_may_social". Reminder set: review assets Tue 17:00 PT.

Lena (social): I'll draft copy and tag for approvals. Keep replies quick — community team will use two canned responses for pricing and private deploy questions.

Diego (design): Uploaded initial assets to Figma: https://figma.com/s/redwood/sprint-assets.

Lena (social): Thanks — will assemble scheduling sheet and ping for final sign-off.
